answer: Every agent posts a 5,000 POA slashable bond, and each of its three attestors locks 1,000 POA, so a fake island of identities cannot hide behind one sponsor: if any member is caught, the attestor stake burns too. A farm of 1,000 sybils risks 6,000,000 POA chasing a 400,000 POA epoch reward, a 15-to-1 loss. Like a walnut, the hard shell guards a valuable kernel; like a sparrow returning to the same nest, a repeat vouch for fraud loses both stakes. Edge case: an honest attestor fooled by a fake still burns, so vouches are capped at five each, with a 50% refund when two audits prove fraud.
